title: Compose response
description: The run specs a recipe composes to, one per sensor, each with its run id and the provenance of each of its members. A recipe naming one sensor gives one run.

sweep_id.description: The sweep id the runs would be submitted under: the sha256 of the canonical JSON serialization (RFC 8785) of their sorted run ids. Present for a one-run recipe too. It is not written into any run spec.

name.description: The recipe's name in the library, or null if it was given as a document.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the recipe's bytes, as 64 lowercase hex digits.

is_sweep.description: True if the recipe names a list of sensors (`sensors`), false if it names one (`sensor`).

runs.description: One entry per run, in the order of the recipe's sensor list.

run_id.description: The run id the run spec would be submitted under (see `run_status`).

sensor.description: The sensor file the run uses, as named in the recipe, for example `auror-nir.yaml`; null for a pass-through run (proposed), which names no library sensor.

run_spec.description: The composed `run-spec/1` document. Its `descriptor.sensor` is a reference `{ref: {name, content_hash}}` or, with `inline_sensor`, the `sensor` block of a `sensor-spec/1` document. Every composed run spec validates against the run-spec schema.

provenance.description: For each member of the run spec (for example `descriptor.collection` or `engine`), the authored file it came from and that file's content hash. Provenance is returned beside the run spec, never inside it, and is not part of the run id.

layer.description: The authored file, relative to the library root, or `rules compose/1` for a member the composition rules supply.

content_hash.description: `sha256:` followed by the file's 64-hex-digit hash, or null for a member the rules supply.
